title_en: Board of Peace says Israel's aid response after Gaza floods 'insufficent'
title_zh: 和平委员会称以色列在加沙洪水后的援助反应“不足”
summary: The group, formed by Trump, issues rare criticism of Israel, while also blaming Hamas for the suffering of civilians in Gaza.
summary_zh: 该组织由特朗普组建，罕见地批评以色列，同时还指责哈马斯应对加沙平民的苦难负责。
body_en: US President Donald Trump's Board of Peace has called on Israel to immediately allow all necessary humanitarian supplies into Gaza after rain flooded tens of thousands of tents.
The US-backed body, established to oversee the implementation of Trump's Gaza peace plan, acknowledged the steps now being considered by Israel, but said "the response remains insufficient".

Israel's military agency in charge of co-ordinating aid into Gaza said it had allowed in tens of thousands of tents and trucks with winter supplies, but added reconstruction "can only begin after Hamas fully disarms".
On Sunday, three children and a woman were killed when a sand embankment collapsed onto tents in the central Strip.
Most people in Gaza have been displaced because of Israel's military actions. Around 65% of the population, about 1.4 million people, now live in tents or makeshift shelters, the UN says.

Standing soaked in Gaza City, Mohammed Jneid told the AFP news agency that heavy rains hit from one side and sewage overflowed on them from the other, with the ground and tents no longer able to hold.
"We have nothing left, no bedding, no food, nothing," he said.
Sitting inside her tent, Islam Al Mobayed told AFP there were seven children there, five of them young.
"This is not life," she said. "We are exhausted, we are tired of this entire life."
In rare criticism of Israel, the Board of Peace said it had been urging the Israeli government to authorise the entry of essential goods for temporary shelter and water and sanitation infrastructure.

The Board added that delays in approving the entry of supplies "exacerbated the consequences of a foreseeable humanitarian challenge" and delayed the start of decommissioning weapons and transferring Hamas authority to a transitional government.
It also said Hamas's failure to disarm and transfer power had compounded the difficulties facing Gaza's civilians.

The UN's humanitarian agency OCHA said more than 150,000 tents were outside Gaza ready to go in, but aid efforts were constrained "by Israeli restrictions on the entry of supplies and equipment and funding shortfalls".
UN humanitarian coordinator Ramiz Alakbarov said on Monday that stocks of essential shelter and winter items inside Gaza had been exhausted.
"Israeli authorities must immediately lift all restrictions on entry of the supplies," he said, adding "we have run out of time".
Israel's foreign ministry spokeswoman Michal Maayan on Monday said Israel had in recent months put in place a winter plan in coordination with the Board of Peace and international charities.

That plan has brought in more than 91,000 tents and 8,200-plus trucks with tarpaulins, blankets, winter clothing, and other equipment, according to Cogat, the Israeli military body responsible for aid.
Cogat said it would not allow in equipment that could be used for military purposes.
Maayon accused Hamas of hoarding aid, saying: "Hamas is responsible for the delays in making more progress in the Strip, and winter-related hardships are a consequence of Hamas's action and policy."

In response to the Board of Peace, Hamas said in a statement published on Palestinian media that its comment "presents a distorted account of the causes of the disaster". The group denied it was responsible for ceasefire delays, pointing to a statement in August , external from Egyptian, Qatari and Turkish mediators that accused Israel of violations.
body_zh: 在雨水淹没了数万顶帐篷后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的和平委员会呼吁以色列立即允许所有必要的人道主义物资进入加沙。
这个由美国支持的机构是为了监督特朗普加沙和平计划的实施而设立的，该机构承认以色列目前正在考虑采取这些步骤，但表示“反应仍然不够”。
负责协调加沙援助的以色列军事机构表示，已允许数以万计的帐篷和卡车运送冬季物资，但补充说，重建工作“只有在哈马斯完全解除武装后才能开始”。
周日，拉斯维加斯大道中部的一座沙堤倒塌压倒了帐篷，导致三名儿童和一名妇女死亡。
由于以色列的军事行动，加沙大多数人流离失所。联合国表示，目前约有 65% 的人口（约 140 万人）居住在帐篷或临时避难所中。
浑身湿透的穆罕默德·杰奈德站在加沙城告诉法新社，大雨从一侧袭来，污水从另一侧溢出，地面和帐篷已经无法支撑。
“我们什么都没有剩下，没有被褥，没有食物，什么都没有，”他说。
伊斯兰·阿尔·莫巴耶德坐在她的帐篷里告诉法新社，那里有七名儿童，其中五名是年轻人。
“这不是生活，”她说。 “我们累了，我们厌倦了这一生。”
和平委员会罕见地批评以色列，表示它一直敦促以色列政府批准临时住所、水和卫生基础设施的必需品入境。
该委员会补充说，延迟批准物资入境“加剧了可预见的人道主义挑战的后果”，并推迟了武器退役和将哈马斯权力移交给过渡政府的开始。
报告还表示，哈马斯未能解除武装和移交权力，加剧了加沙平民面临的困难。
联合国人道主义机构人道协调厅表示，加沙境外有超过15万顶帐篷准备进入，但援助工作“因以色列限制物资和设备进入以及资金短缺”而受到限制。
联合国人道主义协调员拉米兹·阿拉克巴罗夫周一表示，加沙境内的基本避难所和冬季物品库存已经耗尽。
“以色列当局必须立即取消对物资入境的所有限制，”他说，并补充说“我们已经没有时间了”。
以色列外交部发言人米哈尔·马扬周一表示，以色列近几个月与和平委员会和国际慈善机构协调制定了一项冬季计划。
据负责援助的以色列军事机构 Cogat 称，该计划已经运来了 91,000 多个帐篷和 8,200 多辆卡车，其中包括防水布、毯子、冬季服装和其他设备。
Cogat表示，不会允许可用于军事目的的设备入境。
马永指责哈马斯囤积援助，他说：“哈马斯应对加沙地带拖延取得更多进展负责，与冬季有关的困难是哈马斯的行动和政策的结果。”
作为对和平委员会的回应，哈马斯在巴勒斯坦媒体发表的一份声明中表示，其评论“歪曲了灾难原因”。该组织否认自己对停火拖延负有责任，并指出埃及、卡塔尔和土耳其调解员八月份发表的一份声明，指责以色列违反停火协议。

title_en: Kushner and Witkoff renew peace talks to end war between Russia and Ukraine
title_zh: 库什纳和维特科夫重启和平谈判以结束俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争
summary: President Trump's top envoy is in Abu Dhabi with negotiators from Russia and Ukraine to resume peace talks.
summary_zh: 特朗普总统的高级特使正在阿布扎比与俄罗斯和乌克兰的谈判代表一起恢复和平谈判。
body_en: Kushner and Witkoff renew peace talks to end war between Russia and Ukraine President Trump's top envoy is in Abu Dhabi with negotiators from Russia and Ukraine to resume peace talks.
President Trump's top envoy is in Abu Dhabi with negotiators from Russia and Ukraine to resume peace talks.

Some other news now. Russian, American and Ukrainian negotiators are meeting today in Abu Dhabi. They are resuming peace talks over the war in Ukraine - talks that have not happened since February. The U.S. negotiators are presidential envoy Steve Witkoff and presidential son-in-law Jared Kushner. President Trump says he believes peace is achievable this time. NPR's Eleanor Beardsley is covering this from Ukraine's capital, Kyiv. Hey there, Eleanor.
INSKEEP: Other than thousands of additional dead, has anything changed since the last talks nine months ago?

BEARDSLEY: Well, in many ways, nothing has changed. And on the other hand, perhaps a lot is changing. Let me explain. The war still grinds on in eastern Ukraine, where the front line is essentially frozen, though Ukraine did erase minimal Russian gains this year in a fall offensive. We're heading into another winter of Russia targeting Ukraine's energy infrastructure in cities like Kyiv. Putin has not wavered from his maximalist demands. He wants Ukraine to give over the remaining between 20% and 30% of the Donbas region that Russian forces have been unable to conquer. Ukraine still says that's a red line because this fortress belt of cities protects the rest of the country. So that's the same.

BEARDSLEY: And yet, Steve, in the past days, much has changed. Trump and his policies were repudiated in the midterm elections. And while Ukrainians understand this was not about them, they still hope things can change when a new Congress comes in in January. And I spoke with Oleksandr Merezhko. He's chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Ukrainian Parliament. Here he is.

OLEKSANDR MEREZHKO: For us, it's a hopeful sign. And it sort of raised the level of optimism in Ukraine with regard to our relations with the United States because American people and the Congress has always been on the side of Ukraine. And now we hope that the number of supporters of Ukraine in the Congress will rise.
INSKEEP: OK. So a few things are changing. What is different for Russia?

BEARDSLEY: Well, for Russia, the midterms are not good news. Things are going very well with the Trump administration that recently waived sanctions on diesel, which allows Russia to finance this war. So analysts are saying Putin may try to squeeze as much as he can out of the Trump administration before the new Congress comes in.

INSKEEP: OK. At least in foreign affairs, the president still has a lot of latitude. So let's talk about the way the president has discussed this. He says these negotiations could include some larger arrangement for European security, but what makes him think this round could be more successful than in the past?

BEARDSLEY: Well, it's not entirely clear. But U.S. officials speaking on background said they want to create a new long-term security framework that would not just be about Russia and Ukraine but include all of Europe. And the administration says it believes this could possibly unlock concessions from both Kyiv and Moscow.
INSKEEP: OK. So you widen the playing field. You increase the number of players, but Europeans are not part of these negotiations. Is that right?

BEARDSLEY: Yes, Steve. That's right. There are representatives from the U.K., Germany, France and Italy in Abu Dhabi, but they're not taking part directly. That's frightening for Europe. Any changes they want to be preceded by a ceasefire - any talks. Kremlin watchers say this situation for Putin is a dream - to sit down with Trump one-on-one while Europe is sidelined. And there's also a new negotiator on the Russian team. He's the top Kremlin official who - right before the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, he gave the ultimatum to NATO to roll back to its 1997 borders. Steve, that was before Poland and the Baltics joined. I asked Ukrainian lawmaker Inna Sovsun if anything different could come out of these talks. Here she is.
INNA SOVSUN: We see no reason for Putin to suddenly agree to some sort of peace deal. There is no pressure being put on him.

BEARDSLEY: Now, she believes Putin thinks he's winning, especially in Ukrainian cities, where she said she expects Russia to fully use this fifth winter of the war to plunge Ukrainians into the cold and dark in an effort to crush their will.
INSKEEP: Fifth winter of the war. Thank you. Eleanor, thanks so much.
INSKEEP: That's NPR's Eleanor Beardsley in Kyiv.
body_zh: 库什纳和维特科夫重启和平谈判以结束俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争特朗普总统的高级特使正在阿布扎比与俄罗斯和乌克兰的谈判代表一起恢复和平谈判。
特朗普总统的高级特使正在阿布扎比与俄罗斯和乌克兰的谈判代表一起恢复和平谈判。
现在还有一些其他消息。俄罗斯、美国和乌克兰谈判代表今天在阿布扎比举行会议。他们正在恢复有关乌克兰战争的和平谈判——这是自二月份以来从未进行过的谈判。美国谈判代表是总统特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和总统女婿贾里德·库什纳。特朗普总统表示，他相信这次和平是可以实现的。美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley) 在乌克兰首都基辅报道此事。嘿，埃莉诺。
因斯基普：除了数千人死亡之外，自九个月前的上次会谈以来还有什么变化吗？

比尔兹利：嗯，在很多方面，一切都没有改变。另一方面，也许很多事情正在发生变化。让我解释一下。乌克兰东部的战争仍在继续，那里的前线基本上被冻结了，尽管乌克兰确实在今年的秋季攻势中消灭了俄罗斯的最小成果。我们即将进入俄罗斯的另一个冬天，目标是基辅等城市的乌克兰能源基础设施。普京并没有动摇他的最高要求。他希望乌克兰交出俄罗斯军队无法征服的剩余20%至30%的顿巴斯地区。乌克兰仍然称这是一条红线，因为这条城市堡垒带保护着该国其他地区。所以那是一样的。
比尔兹利：然而，史蒂夫，在过去的日子里，发生了很多变化。特朗普及其政策在中期选举中遭到否定。尽管乌克兰人明白这与他们无关，但他们仍然希望一月份新国会成立时事情能够改变。我与亚历山大·梅列日科进行了交谈。他是乌克兰议会外交事务委员会主席。他在这里。
OLEKSANDR MEREZHKO：对我们来说，这是一个充满希望的迹象。这在某种程度上提高了乌克兰对我们与美国关系的乐观程度，因为美国人民和国会一直站在乌克兰一边。现在我们希望国会中乌克兰的支持者人数能够增加。
因斯基普：好的。所以有些事情正在改变。俄罗斯有何不同？
比尔兹利：对于俄罗斯来说，中期选举并不是好消息。特朗普政府最近放弃了对柴油的制裁，这使得俄罗斯能够为这场战争提供资金，事情进展顺利。因此分析人士表示，普京可能会在新一届国会就任之前，尽可能地从特朗普政府中挤出权力。
因斯基普：好的。至少在外交事务上，总统还有很大的自由度。那么我们来谈谈总统讨论这个问题的方式。他表示，这些谈判可能包括一些更大的欧洲安全安排，但是什么让他认为这一轮谈判可能比过去更成功？
比尔兹利：嗯，目前还不完全清楚。但美国官员在背景发言中表示，他们希望建立一个新的长期安全框架，该框架不仅涉及俄罗斯和乌克兰，还包括整个欧洲。美国政府表示，它相信这可能会促使基辅和莫斯科双方做出让步。
因斯基普：好的。所以你扩大了竞争环境。你增加了球员的数量，但欧洲人不参与这些谈判。是这样吗？

比尔兹利：是的，史蒂夫。这是正确的。阿布扎比有来自英国、德国、法国和意大利的代表，但他们并没有直接参加。这对欧洲来说是可怕的。他们希望在任何改变之前先停火——任何谈判。克里姆林宫观察人士表示，对于普京来说，这种情况是一个梦想——在欧洲处于边缘地位的情况下与特朗普一对一地坐下来。俄罗斯团队中还有一位新的谈判代表。他是克里姆林宫的最高官​​员，就在全面入侵乌克兰之前，他向北约发出了最后通牒，要求其退回 1997 年的边界。史蒂夫，那是在波兰和波罗的海国家加入之前。我问乌克兰议员因娜·索夫孙（Inna Sovsun）这些会谈是否会产生不同的结果。她在这里。
伊纳·索夫孙：我们认为普京没有理由突然同意某种和平协议。他没有受到任何压力。
比尔兹利：现在，她相信普京认为自己正在获胜，特别是在乌克兰城市，她说她希望俄罗斯充分利用战争的第五个冬天，让乌克兰人陷入寒冷和黑暗，以粉碎他们的意志。
因斯基普：战争的第五个冬天。谢谢。埃莉诺，非常感谢。
因斯基普：这是基辅 NPR 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley)。

title_en: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
title_zh: 泽伦斯基表示乌克兰和谈第一天具有建设性
summary: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.
summary_zh: 来自基辅、华盛顿和莫斯科的代表团正在阿拉伯联合酋长国参加自二月份以来的首次三边会谈。
body_en: By Laura Gozzi and Abdujalil Abdurasulov , Reporting from Kyiv
The first of two days of trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine has concluded in Abu Dhabi.

While senior officials from Kyiv and Moscow were tight-lipped after the four hour-long discussions, President Volodymyr Zelensky, who was not at the talks, said they had proved "constructive and quite substantive".
Speaking from Paris, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio also said the meeting had been "very productive".

Although expectations for a breakthrough that ends Russia's full-scale war on Ukraine are low, US officials said earlier that Moscow and Kyiv were privately showing "a little bit of flexibility" on the issue of who would control Ukraine's eastern regions in a postwar scenario.
Zelensky also said that humanitarian issues such as prisoner of war exchanges had been discussed.

At the start of Tuesday's talks President Donald Trump's son-in-law, Jared Kushner, told delegates that the US had "narrowed the gaps" between the two sides, without providing details, and hoped to move towards a "solution that hopefully ends the war".
Kushner had said earlier the talks would be focused on addressing the "postwar security concerns" of both Russia and Ukraine.
Asked later at a news conference in Copenhagen about the approach of US officials to negotiations, Zelensky said: "I see changes. I'm very happy with what I hear."
Kushner and Trump peace envoy Steve Witkoff also met Ukrainian and European and Nato officials on the sidelines of the main meeting.

Until now European leaders have largely been excluded from peace talks, but they have pushed to be included in the discussions amid concerns that decisions about their continent's security would be made without them.
The Americans appear to support this, with Rubio acknowledging during a visit to Paris that the Europeans "are a part of solving this problem for the long term".
However, "the Russians have a bad taste in their mouth with the Europeans", according to a US official.

Some proposals favoured by EU officials - such as calling an unconditional ceasefire as a prerequisite for peace negotiations - are routinely rejected by Moscow. Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said on Tuesday that a truce would just allow Kyiv to regroup. "We will not agree to it," he said.
Moscow and Kyiv's positions are still far apart on ending the conflict.
A key area of disagreement involves Ukraine's eastern region of Donetsk, which is mostly occupied by Russia.

Moscow has demanded that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk it still holds, while Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those areas, which it says are crucial to its future security.

While neither side has budged on these demands, the US official speaking on the eve of the talks suggested that this was just the public stance and that Moscow and Kyiv had shown "a little bit of flexibility, privately".
However, he acknowledged the issue would not be solved without discussions about a new "security architecture".

"They will not solve the Donetsk issue and the territorial issue until they know what the security architecture is going to be after the war," the official said. "And keep in mind, we're not going to be able to finalise one without the other."
body_zh: 作者：Laura Gozzi 和 Abdujalil Abdurasulov，基辅报道
乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国旨在结束乌克兰战争的为期两天的三边会谈的第一场在阿布扎比结束。
尽管基辅和莫斯科的高级官员在长达四个小时的讨论后守口如瓶，但没有参加会谈的总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基表示，事实证明他们“具有建设性且相当实质性”。
美国国务卿卢比奥在巴黎发表讲话时也表示，这次会议“非常富有成效”。
尽管人们对结束俄罗斯对乌克兰全面战争的突破的期望很低，但美国官员早些时候表示，莫斯科和基辅私下在谁将在战后控制乌克兰东部地区的问题上表现出“一点灵活性”。
泽连斯基还表示，已经讨论了战俘交换等人道主义问题。
在周二的会谈开始时，唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳告诉代表们，美国已经“缩小了双方之间的分歧”，但没有提供细节，并希望达成“有望结束战争的解决方案”。
库什纳早些时候曾表示，会谈的重点是解决俄罗斯和乌克兰的“战后安全问题”。
后来在哥本哈根举行的新闻发布会上被问及美国官员对谈判的态度时，泽伦斯基说：“我看到了变化。我对所听到的感到非常满意。”
库什纳和特朗普和平特使史蒂夫·威特科夫还在主会议间隙会见了乌克兰、欧洲和北约官员。
到目前为止，欧洲领导人基本上被排除在和平谈判之外，但由于担心欧洲领导人在没有他们的情况下将做出有关欧洲大陆安全的决定，他们一直在推动参与讨论。
美国人似乎支持这一点，卢比奥在访问巴黎期间承认欧洲人“是长期解决这个问题的一部分”。
然而，一位美国官员表示，“俄罗斯人对欧洲人的印象很差”。
欧盟官员青睐的一些建议——例如将无条件停火作为和平谈判的先决条件——经常遭到莫斯科的拒绝。俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫周二表示，停战只会让基辅重新集结。 “我们不会同意，”他说。
莫斯科和基辅在结束冲突方面的立场仍然存在很大分歧。
分歧的一个关键领域涉及乌克兰东部顿涅茨克地区，该地区大部分被俄罗斯占领。
莫斯科要求乌克兰放弃其仍控制的顿涅茨克部分地区，而基辅则希望冻结接触线以保持对这些地区的控制，并称这对其未来的安全至关重要。
尽管双方都没有对这些要求做出让步，但美国官员在会谈前夕表示，这只是公开立场，莫斯科和基辅“私下里表现出了一点灵活性”。
然而，他承认，如果不讨论新的“安全架构”，这个问题就无法解决。
这位官员表示：“他们不会解决顿涅茨克问题和领土问题，除非他们知道战后的安全架构将是什么。” “请记住，如果没有另一个，我们将无法最终确定其中一个。”

body_en: As the US Midterms reshape Ukraine diplomacy, Annette Young is pleased to welcome James Townsend, Atlantic Council's Senior Advisor at the Scowcroft Center's for Transatlantic Security Initiative. "Europe is not going anywhere." With this unequivocal assessment, Townsend, taking place alongside trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi. While the latter may command international attention, Townsend argues that the Paris meeting carries a message of its own: European support for Ukraine is intended to remain durable, and Moscow should not mistake diplomatic negotiations for an erosion of Western resolve. The G7 meeting therefore emerges as more than a forum for diplomatic declarations. It represents a test of Western cohesion, the credibility of future military and financial assistance, and Washington's willingness to endorse a common position on Ukraine. As Townsend emphasizes, the final communiqué will also be "a test as far as what Marco Rubio is going to agree to put his name to."

title_en: British counterterrorism police arrest US soldier accused of spying on behalf of Russia
title_zh: 英国反恐警察逮捕被指控为俄罗斯从事间谍活动的美国士兵
summary: A member of the US Army has been arrested near Gloucester in England. Police said he was suspected of espionage activity in connection with Russia. Investigators from the US and UK are involved in the probe.
summary_zh: 一名美国陆军成员在英格兰格洛斯特附近被捕。警方表示，他涉嫌从事与俄罗斯有关的间谍活动。在
body_en: US soldier arrested in UK on Russian espionage allegations
A 41-year-old member of the US Army was arrested near Gloucester on Tuesday in England, the Metropolitan Police said in a statement .
Authorities were searched two locations in the Gloucestershire region, police said, adding: "The country to which the allegations pertain is Russia."
US authorities, the US Military and the FBI were closely involved in the investigation, police said.
The man was in custody at a London police station, authorities said on Tuesday evening as the news emerged.
What did US and UK officials say about the arrest?

Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans, Senior National Coordinator for Counter Terrorism Policing called it a "significant arrest" as a result of "close collaboration between UK and US authorities."
"The allegations are serious and our investigation is very much ongoing," Evans said.
FBI Director Kash Patel said the case was of "utmost concern" to the US and its allies.

"While this investigation is continuing, I want to send a clear message — this FBI has no tolerance for anyone who breaks their oath to the United States and whose actions endanger our national security and that of our partners," Patel said. He also expressed thanks to UK investigators across various branches and the US Military Counterintelligence Command "for their outstanding work."
Brigadier General Sean Stinchon, the commanding general of US Army Counterintelligence Command also said the case demonstrated the "resolve of the counterintelligence community."
"The alleged conduct of a senior soldier, entrusted with sensitive information, is a sobering reminder that insider threats are real and persistent," Stinchon said.
Busy area for US and UK military, intelligence communities

The area around Gloucestershire in the west of England, around two hours' drive from London, is home to several sensitive military and intelligence sites as well as outposts for various British and US companies with ties to the defense industry.
RAF Fairford, which was in the news earlier this year amid a security scare at the vast airbase used by both UK and US planes, is not far southeast of Gloucester.
Gloucester's neighboring town, Cheltenham, is one the UK's intelligence hubs outside London. It is home to the headquarters of the country's signals intelligence agency GCHQ.

body_zh: 美国士兵因俄罗斯间谍指控在英国被捕
英国伦敦警察厅在一份声明中称，周二，一名 41 岁的美国陆军成员在英格兰格洛斯特附近被捕。
警方表示，当局搜查了格洛斯特郡地区的两个地点，并补充说：“指控所涉国家是俄罗斯。”
警方表示，美国当局、美国军方和联邦调查局密切参与了调查。
周二晚间消息传出后，当局表示，该男子已被拘留在伦敦警察局。
美国和英国官员对此次逮捕有何评论？
副助理专员、国家反恐警务高级协调员维姬·埃文斯 (Vicki Evans) 称这是“英国和美国当局密切合作”的“重大逮捕”。
埃文斯说：“这些指控很严重，我们的调查正在进行中。”
联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔表示，美国及其盟国“最关注”此案。
帕特尔说：“在调查仍在继续的同时，我想发出一个明确的信息——联邦调查局不会容忍任何违背对美国誓言、危害我们和合作伙伴国家安全的人。”他还对英国各部门调查人员和美国军事反情报司令部“出色的工作”表示感谢。
美国陆军反情报司令部司令肖恩·斯廷琼准将也表示，此案展示了“反情报界的决心”。
斯廷琼说：“一名被委托掌握敏感信息的高级士兵的行为令人警醒，提醒我们内部威胁是真实且持续的。”
美国和英国军事、情报部门的繁忙地区
英格兰西部格洛斯特郡周边地区距离伦敦约两小时车程，是多个敏感军事和情报站点的所在地，也是与国防工业有联系的多家英国和美国公司的前哨基地。
英国皇家空军费尔福德机场位于格洛斯特东南部不远的地方，今年早些时候，由于英国和美国飞机使用的大型空军基地出现安全恐慌，该基地曾出现在新闻中。
格洛斯特的邻近城镇切尔滕纳姆是英国伦敦以外的情报中心之一。它是该国信号情报机构 GCHQ 的总部所在地。

title_en: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest
title_zh: 孟加拉国爆发暴力事件，被罢免总理的支持者举行抗议
summary: Supporters of Sheikh Hasina want her to return from exile in India.
summary_zh: 谢赫·哈西娜的支持者希望她从印度流亡归来。
body_en: Police in Bangladesh have fired tear gas and rubber bullets to disperse supporters of the deposed Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who are demanding her return to the country.
A police vehicle was set on fire in Gopalganj district, where the banned student wing of Hasina's Awami League party clashed with security forces.
Nationwide protests by pro-Hasina activists started a day after the former leader said she had requested a passport to return to Bangladesh from exile in India.

The demonstrations by the student wing, called Bangladesh Chhatra League (BCL), are seen as the first organised show of force by Hasina's supporters since she was ousted in August 2024 following a huge uprising against her rule .
Traffic was disrupted in some parts of the country as protesters tried to set up roadblocks using burning tyres.
Several passenger vehicles were also set on fire in various parts of Bangladesh in the run up to the protest.
A 60-year-old driver of a passenger bus was killed by smoke inhalation after people set fire to the vehicle in the city of Faridpur early on Tuesday.
Elsewhere, about 200 protesters briefly blocked traffic on the 6.2km (4 mile)-long Padma bridge across the Ganges, that connects the capital Dhaka with the south-western region.
Bangladeshi local media said dozens of crude bombs exploded in the past few days in Dhaka and elsewhere.

"Any attempt to worsen the law-and-order situation or create instability through any conspiracy within the country from across the border (India) will not be allowed to succeed," Bangladesh Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed said.

"Our supporters were not responsible for the violent incidents. They were carried out by unknown miscreants. We believe in peaceful protests," a senior leader of the BCL, who is now in exile in a foreign country, said.
Hasina fled to neighbouring India two years ago following a massive uprising, bringing an end to her 15-year reign.
Opposition parties accused Hasina of jailing political rivals, supressing dissent and overseeing widespread human rights abuses. She always denied the charges.
The United Nations has estimated up to 1,400 people were killed , most by gunfire from security forces, during the anti-government protests in 2024.
The activities of the Awami League were banned soon after she fled the country and it was not allowed to contest the February general election.
A special Bangladeshi tribunal last year sentenced her to death in absentia after being found guilty of crimes against humanity.
She has denied all the charges, calling the trial "biased and politically motivated".
Despite the death penalty threat, Hasina said she wanted to return to Bangladesh in December and requesteded the Bangladesh High Commission in New Delhi to issue her with a passport.
But the Bangladeshi government said the country would not provide a passport to her and called her "a terrorist".
"She is a fugitive criminal. We have an active extradition treaty with India. We want her handed over," Humaiun Kobir, Bangladesh's junior foreign affairs minister, said.
body_zh: 孟加拉国警方发射催泪瓦斯和橡皮子弹驱散被废黜总理谢赫·哈西娜的支持者，他们要求她返回该国。
戈帕尔甘杰区一辆警车被纵火，哈西娜领导的人民联盟党被禁止的学生派别与安全部队发生冲突。
前领导人哈西娜表示，她已要求获得护照，以便从印度流亡返回孟加拉国，一天后，支持哈西娜的活动人士开始了全国范围的抗议活动。
名为孟加拉国查特拉联盟 (BCL) 的学生组织的示威活动被视为哈西娜支持者自 2024 年 8 月因反对其统治的大规模起义而被赶下台以来首次有组织的武力展示。
由于抗议者试图用燃烧的轮胎设置路障，该国部分地区的交通受到干扰。
在抗议活动之前，孟加拉国各地也有几辆客车被纵火焚烧。
周二早些时候，法里德布尔市一辆客车被人放火，一名 60 岁的司机因吸入烟雾而身亡。
在其他地方，约 200 名抗议者短暂封锁了横跨恒河、连接首都达卡和西南部地区的 6.2 公里（4 英里）长的帕德玛大桥上的交通。
孟加拉国当地媒体称，过去几天在达卡和其他地方发生了数十枚粗制炸弹爆炸。
孟加拉国内政部长萨拉胡丁·艾哈迈德表示：“任何企图通过越过边境（印度）在国内制造混乱或制造不稳定的企图都不会得逞。”
“我们的支持者对这些暴力事件不负有责任。这些事件是由身份不明的歹徒所为。我们相信和平抗议，”目前流亡国外的BCL高级领导人表示。
两年前，哈西娜在一场大规模起义后逃往邻国印度，结束了她15年的统治。
反对党指责哈西娜监禁政治对手、镇压异见并监督广泛的侵犯人权行为。她始终否认这些指控。
联合国估计 2024 年的反政府抗议活动中有多达 1,400 人死亡，其中大部分是安全部队开枪造成的。
她逃离该国后不久，人民联盟的活动就被禁止，也不允许参加二月份的大选。
去年，孟加拉国一个特别法庭在被判犯有反人类罪后缺席判处她死刑。
她否认了所有指控，称审判“有偏见且具有政治动机”。
尽管面临死刑威胁，哈西娜表示她想在 12 月返回孟加拉国，并请求位于新德里的孟加拉国高级专员公署向她发放护照。
但孟加拉国政府表示，该国不会向她提供护照，并称她为“恐怖分子”。
“她是一名逃犯。我们与印度签订了有效的引渡条约。我们希望将她移交，”孟加拉国外交部初级部长胡迈恩·科比尔说。

title_en: Makers of GLP-1 drugs ordered to add warnings about rare eye condition that can lead to blindness
title_zh: GLP-1 药物制造商被勒令添加有关可能导致失明的罕见眼部疾病的警告
summary: The US Food and Drug Administration says Ozempic, Wegovy, and other weight-loss drugs must have labels about the condition, known as NAION.
summary_zh: 美国食品和药物管理局表示，Ozempic、Wegovy 和其他减肥药物必须贴有有关这种病症（称为 NAION）的标签。
body_en: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) told makers of popular weight-loss GLP-1 drugs that they must add warning labels about a rare eye condition that can cause sudden blindness.

Manufacturers of Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro and Zepbound must warn about nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION). The disorder happens when vessels supplying blood to the optic nerves become blocked, depriving the nerves of oxygen.
The condition can cause painless decreased vision in one eye, which can be permanent, the FDA said.
In a statement to the BBC, the American Academy of Ophthalmology said "any added risk appears small, and it has not been established that these medications cause NAION".

"GLP-1 medications offer important benefits for people with diabetes, obesity, and heart disease, so our message to patients is simple," the group said. "Don't stop your medication without talking to your doctor, and if you notice sudden, painless vision loss in one eye, see an ophthalmologist promptly."
There is no known treatment to reverse vision loss caused by NAION. It is the most common cause of acute optic nerve injury in people over 50 years old, according to the academy.

The FDA said it conducted a detailed review of reports of NAION in GLP-1 users as well as a review of other studies and concluded there is an "increased risk of rare NAION events" in people taking the drugs.
In a statement, Novo Nordisk, the manufacturer of Wegovy, one of the most popular weight-loss medications, said the company believes the data "do not establish a cause-and-effect relationship".

"We recognize that NAION can have a profound impact on patients and their families. Patient safety is a top priority for Novo, and we continue to monitor the safety of our medicines," the manufacturer said.

Some research was challenging to review because people taking GLP-1 drugs for obesity and type 2 diabetes may already have risk factors for NAION separate from the drugs, according to the regulator. The FDA said it was not known why those taking GLP-1 drugs may be more at risk for the eye condition.

The drugs already have warning labels for several other conditions including pancreatitis and gallbladder disease. Some of the most common symptoms for semaglutide - a key ingredient in many GLP-1 drugs - include nausea, vomiting and stomach pain.
⁠Last year, a safety arm of the European Medicines Agency, a part of the European Union, said up to 1 in 10,000 people taking semaglutide may be affected by NAION.
In a study published two years ago analysing 17,000 patients, US researchers found those taking semaglutide were four times more likely to be diagnosed with NAION than those not taking the drug.

But one of the authors of the study, Harvard Medical School ophthalmology professor Dr Joseph Rizzo, said the findings were "significant but tentative", and more research was needed on the relationship between the drug and the eye condition in a more diverse population.

body_zh: 美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 告诉流行的 GLP-1 减肥药物制造商，他们必须添加关于一种可能导致突然失明的罕见眼部疾病的警告标签。
Ozempic、Wegovy、Mounjaro 和 Zepbound 的制造商必须警告非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变 (NAION)。当向视神经供血的血管被阻塞，神经缺氧时，就会发生这种疾病。
FDA 表示，这种情况会导致一只眼睛的无痛视力下降，这可能是永久性的。
美国眼科学会在给 BBC 的一份声明中表示，“任何增加的风险似乎都很小，而且尚未确定这些药物是否会导致 NAION”。
该组织表示：“GLP-1 药物为糖尿病、肥胖和心脏病患者提供了重要的益处，因此我们向患者传达的信息很简单。” “在没有咨询医生的情况下，不要停止用药，如果您发现一只眼睛突然出现无痛视力丧失，请立即去看眼科医生。”
目前尚无已知的治疗方法可以逆转 NAION 引起的视力丧失。据该学院称，这是 50 岁以上人群急性视神经损伤的最常见原因。
FDA 表示，它对 GLP-1 使用者的 NAION 报告以及其他研究进行了详细审查，并得出结论，服用该药物的人“发生罕见 NAION 事件的风险增加”。
最受欢迎的减肥药物之一 Wegovy 的制造商诺和诺德在一份声明中表示，该公司认为这些数据“并未建立因果关系”。
“我们认识到 NAION 可以对患者及其家人产生深远的影响。患者安全是 Novo 的首要任务，我们将继续监控我们药品的安全性，”制造商表示。
监管机构称，一些研究难以审查，因为服用 GLP-1 药物治疗肥胖和 2 型糖尿病的人可能已经存在与药物无关的 NAION 风险因素。 FDA 表示，目前尚不清楚为什么服用 GLP-1 药物的人患眼部疾病的风险更大。
这些药物已经有针对其他几种疾病的警告标签，包括胰腺炎和胆囊疾病。索马鲁肽（许多 GLP-1 药物的关键成分）的一些最常见症状包括恶心、呕吐和胃痛。
⁠去年，欧盟所属欧洲药品管理局的一个安全部门表示，服用索马鲁肽的人中，多达万分之一可能会受到 NAION 的影响。
在两年前发表的一项对 17,000 名患者进行分析的研究中，美国研究人员发现服用索马鲁肽的患者被诊断患有 NAION 的可能性是未服用该药物的患者的四倍。
但该研究的作者之一、哈佛医学院眼科教授 Joseph Rizzo 博士表示，这些发现“意义重大，但只是暂时的”，需要在更多样化的人群中对该药物与眼部状况之间的关系进行更多研究。

title_en: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
title_zh: 以色列新议会宣誓就职，领导人竞相组建政府
summary: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.
summary_zh: 本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的主要政治对手加迪·艾森科特首次有机会组建新政府并罢免总理。
body_en: Israel's new parliament has been sworn in, as opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot seeks to oust caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

The former army chief has been tasked with forming a government after receiving more recommendations from members of the Knesset than Netanyahu, although not all those backing him are willing to govern together.

Eisenkot's bloc of four parties won 48 seats in October's election, while Netanyahu's bloc won 53, leaving both short of a majority in the 120-seat Knesset. He has 28 days to build a coalition, with a possible two-week extension.
Almost half of the new MKs did not serve in the previous parliament, while Arab-led parties have a record number of seats.
Shortly after they were sworn in, Netanyahu and Eisenkot warned parliament about the perils of supporting a government led by the other.

"[And] to those who are thinking of establishing a government that includes supporters of terror and haters of Israel, or that will be dependent on them, I ask you, are you prepared to be dependent on those whose goal is the destruction of the Jewish state?" said Netanyahu, alluding to the prospect of an Eisenkot-led government reliant on support from Arab parties.
He also appealed for the formation of a government of national unity as the only way to confront what he said was the threat of "a nuclear Iran".
Eisenkot sharply criticised Netanyahu's comments.

"I sat and listened to the outgoing prime minister's delusional, divisive, hate-filled and shameful speech, exploiting a state occasion," he said. "I am now even more convinced that he is unfit to remain in office for even one more minute."

The outcome of the election, which was widely seen as a referendum on Netanyahu, means there is a period of uncertainty over who will form the next government. Netanyahu will remain caretaker prime minister until then - a process which could take from days to months.

One of the most dramatic results was the performance of Israel's two Arab-led alliances - the United Arab List and the Joint List - which won an unprecedented 19 seats between them following a surge in turnout among Arab voters.

The Arab parties could therefore hold the balance of power, although Netanyahu has ruled out governing with them and three of the parties in Eisenkot's bloc have opposed including them in a coalition.
On Sunday, President Isaac Herzog tasked Eisenkot with trying to form a government.

Speaking at the president's residence, the centrist Yashar party leader called for the formation of a "national emergency government" - an implicit appeal to parties to put ideological differences aside to remove Netanyahu from office.
This, he said, would "require creative and unconventional political steps".

Eisenkot said any party or MK prepared to accept four principles could join his proposed government. Those are recognition of Israel as a Jewish and democratic state; accepting the values of the Declaration of Independence; backing mandatory military, national or civilian service for all, including communities currently exempt; and recognising Hamas as a terrorist organisation and committing to dismantling its military and governing capabilities.
The four requirements, however, could present significant obstacles to Eisenkot's potential partners.
The conscription of ultra-Orthodox Jewish men, who are exempt from military service if they are in full-time religious study, was a major election issue.

The ultra-Orthodox United Torah Judaism (UTJ) and Shas parties, which won 13 seats in total, have fiercely objected to attempts to change the status quo - something that all parties in Eisenkot's bloc campaigned to do.

Eisenkot's four principles are also contentious for the Arab parties. Both emphasise equal national and civic rights for Israel's Arab citizens, who form about 20% of the population; the vast majority of Israeli Arabs are not required to serve in the military; and neither has publicly recognised Hamas as a terrorist organisation.
body_zh: 以色列新议会已宣誓就职，反对党领袖加迪·艾森科特试图推翻看守总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡。
这位前陆军参谋长在获得比内塔尼亚胡更多的议会成员推荐后，被任命组建政府，尽管并非所有支持他的人都愿意一起执政。
艾森科特的四党集团在 10 月份的选举中赢得了 48 个席位，而内塔尼亚胡的集团赢得了 53 个席位，使得双方都未能在议会 120 个席位中获得多数席位。他有 28 天的时间建立联盟，并可能延长两周。
近一半的新议员没有在上届议会任职，而阿拉伯领导的政党则拥有创纪录的席位。
宣誓就职后不久，内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特就向议会发出警告，支持对方领导的政府存在危险。
“[并且]对于那些正在考虑建立一个包括恐怖分子支持者和以色列仇恨者的政府的人，或者将依赖他们的人，我问你们，你们准备好依赖那些目标是摧毁犹太国家的人了吗？”内塔尼亚胡说，暗指艾森科特领导的政府依赖阿拉伯政党支持的前景。
他还呼吁组建民族团结政府，这是应对他所说的“有核伊朗”威胁的唯一途径。
艾森科特严厉批评了内塔尼亚胡的言论。
他说：“我坐在那里，聆听即将离任的总理利用国家场合发表的妄想、分裂、充满仇恨和可耻的讲话。” “我现在更加确信他不适合再留任一分钟。”
这次选举的结果被广泛视为对内塔尼亚胡的公投，意味着下一届政府的组成存在一段不确定时期。在此之前内塔尼亚胡将继续担任看守总理，这一过程可能需要几天到几个月的时间。
最引人注目的结果之一是以色列两个阿拉伯领导的联盟——阿拉伯联合名单和联合名单——的表现，在阿拉伯选民投票率激增后，这两个联盟史无前例地赢得了 19 个席位。
因此，阿拉伯政党可以保持权力平衡，尽管内塔尼亚胡已经排除了与他们一起执政的可能性，而且艾森科特集团中的三个政党也反对将他们纳入联合政府。
周日，总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格责成艾森科特尝试组建政府。
中间派亚沙尔党领导人在总统官邸发表讲话，呼吁组建“国家紧急政府”——含蓄地呼吁各党抛开意识形态分歧，将内塔尼亚胡赶下台。
他说，这“需要创造性和非常规的政治步骤”。
艾森科特表示，任何愿意接受四项原则的政党或人民党都可以加入他提议的政府。这些是承认以色列是一个犹太民主国家；接受《独立宣言》的价值观；支持所有人，包括目前豁免的社区，强制服兵役、国民服役或民事服役；承认哈马斯为恐怖组织，并承诺削弱其军事和治理能力。
然而，这四项要求可能会给艾森科特的潜在合作伙伴带来重大障碍。
征召极端正统的犹太男子是一个重大的选举问题，如果他们接受全日制宗教学习，就可以免除兵役。
极端正统的联合托拉犹太教（UTJ）和沙斯党总共赢得了 13 个席位，他们强烈反对改变现状的尝试——艾森科特集团中所有政党都在竞选这一目标。
艾森科特的四项原则对于阿拉伯政党来说也存在争议。两者都强调占以色列人口约 20% 的阿拉伯公民的平等民族权利和公民权利；绝大多数以色列阿拉伯人不需要服兵役；双方都没有公开承认哈马斯是恐怖组织。

title_zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿访问埃及拉法过境点和加沙援助设施
summary: Seven-time F1 world champion tours border area and logistics warehouses operated by Egyptian Red Crescent Lewis Hamilton has visited Egypt’s Rafah border crossing with the Gaza Strip to meet organisations sending humanitarian aid to the territory. The seven-ti
summary_zh: 七届F1世界冠军巡游边境地区和埃及红新月会运营的物流仓库刘易斯·汉密尔顿访问了埃及拉法博尔
body_en: Seven-time F1 world champion tours border area and logistics warehouses operated by Egyptian Red Crescent
Lewis Hamilton has visited Egypt’s Rafah border crossing with the Gaza Strip to meet organisations sending humanitarian aid to the territory.

The seven-time Formula One world champion has spoken out about conflict and humanitarian crises in the region, and has called for peace. He has frequently posted on social media about children killed in Israeli airstrikes in Gaza and called for a ceasefire.
“I think we need to make sure we’re pushing to free Congo, free Sudan, free Syria, free Palestine . I think there’s a lot of peace that I’m hoping we get to at some stage,” Hamilton said in October.

A ceasefire agreement reached last year has halted major combat operations in Gaza, but the amount of aid reaching the territory continues to fall far short of the agreed-upon minimum of 600 trucks a day.
Israeli forces have continued to advance, expanding their control from 53% of the territory to at least 60%, an independent commission of UN experts said last month.
Airstrikes also continue, and Israeli fire along the advancing front has killed at least 196 Palestinians, including 18 women, 32 boys and 11 girls, the commission said.
Hamilton toured Egypt’s Rafah border crossing with Gaza before visiting logistics warehouses operated by the Egyptian Red Crescent, which facilitates the entry of aid to Gaza.
At the crossing, Hamilton greeted aid workers with “Assalamu alaikum” a widely used Arabic greeting meaning “peace be upon you.” He shook hands and briefly spoke to workers and officials.
Khaled Megawer, the governor of North Sinai, where Rafah is located, said the visit was intended to help Hamilton learn about Egypt’s efforts to send aid to Gaza.
The visit comes after Hamilton made his 400th race start on Sunday at the São Paulo Grand Prix at Interlagos.
The first black F1 driver, he made his debut with McLaren in 2007. He is only the second F1 driver to start 400 races after his former teammate Fernando Alonso, who achieved the milestone in 2024.

刘易斯·汉密尔顿访问了埃及与加沙地带的拉法过境点，会见了向该地区提供人道主义援助的组织。
这位七届一级方程式世界冠军公开谈论了该地区的冲突和人道主义危机，并呼吁和平。他经常在社交媒体上发布有关以色列在加沙空袭中丧生的儿童的信息，并呼吁停火。
“我认为我们需要确保我们正在推动自由刚果、自由苏丹、自由叙利亚、自由巴勒斯坦。我认为我希望我们在某个阶段能够实现很多和平，”汉密尔顿在十月份表示。
去年达成的停火协议已经停止了加沙的主要战斗行动，但运抵该地区的援助物资数量仍然远远低于商定的每天 600 辆卡车的最低限度。
联合国专家独立委员会上个月表示，以色列军队继续推进，将其控制范围从 53% 扩大到至少 60%。
委员会称，空袭仍在继续，以色列沿前线开火已造成至少 196 名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中包括 18 名妇女、32 名男孩和 11 名女孩。
汉密尔顿参观了埃及与加沙的拉法过境点，然后参观了埃及红新月会运营的物流仓库，该仓库为援助物资进入加沙提供了便利。
在过境点，汉密尔顿用“Assalamu alaikum”向援助人员打招呼，这是一种广泛使用的阿拉伯语问候语，意思是“愿你平安”。他与工人和官员握手并简短交谈。
拉法所在的北西奈省省长哈立德·梅加维尔表示，这次访问的目的是帮助汉密尔顿了解埃及向加沙提供援助的努力。
这次访问是在汉密尔顿于周日在英特拉格斯举行的圣保罗大奖赛上完成他的第 400 场比赛之后进行的。
作为第一位黑人 F1 车手，他于 2007 年在迈凯伦首次亮相。他是继前队友费尔南多·阿隆索（2024 年实现这一里程碑）之后第二位参加 400 场比赛的 F1 车手。

title_en: French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104
title_zh: 法国抗战女英雄索兰热·亚历山大去世，享年 104 岁
summary: With 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and joined the fight against the occupying German forces.
summary_zh: 她率领 30 名士兵组织破坏行动，为盟军飞行员提供庇护，并参加了对抗德国占领军的战斗。
body_en: One of France's last Resistance heroes from World War Two has died at the age of 104. Solange Alexandre was also a rare woman who, with her future husband, created and commanded her own unit of anti-German fighters.
After serving as a Resistance courier from 1941, three years later she founded the Pas-de-Boeuf network near the town of Ruillé-sur-Loir.

With some 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and, after the Allied landings in Normandy on D-Day in 1944, joined the fight against the occupying German forces.
President Emmanuel Macron was among many to pay tribute to Alexandre, after her death was announced at a nursing home in Le Mans.
"She said she only ever did her duty. But her duty was our freedom. France will never forget. Thank you," Macron posted on social media.
Born in 1922 in the Sarthe department of western France, Solange Alexandre, née Dubuisson, grew up in a patriotic family that had suffered in World War One.
"My mother lost her first husband in the war, and my father was wounded in 1917. The words homeland and honour were very important to us. They were in my blood," she recalled in her memoirs.

In June 1940 she heard on the radio the appeal from General Charles de Gaulle in London, calling on the French not to give up the struggle against Germany. She had never heard of him, but that did not matter.
"From that moment I knew I had to join up," she wrote.
Some months later she was recruited by a friend of her father's – a Tunisian-born French army veteran called Saïd Belhaffaf, who had joined the Resistance.
Using the code-name Corlay, she criss-crossed the region around Le Mans by bicycle, gathering information and passing on messages.
"There were no mobile phones back then, and no private cars either because of the lack of petrol. The bicycle was king," she said in an interview two years ago.
In 1943 she met her first husband Guy Déliot, who had deserted from the French gendarmerie after refusing to arrest some Jews.
The following April, with the Allied invasion approaching, they decided to take to the maquis, in other words live clandestinely in the forested hills, supplied with food by local farmers.

Their group consisted of deserters from German forced labour programmes, as well as survivors from another Resistance outfit that had been destroyed by the enemy. There were also two airmen, one American and one Canadian.
"Twice the Gestapo came for me, and twice I slipped through their hands," she later recalled.
After taking part in the liberation of Tours in September 1944, she ended the war with the rank of sub-lieutenant in the French Interior Forces (FFI).

Later she worked as a teacher and followed her husband on his many postings as an officer of the gendarmerie in French overseas territories. He was killed in 1960 in Martinique, and in 1981 she remarried.
Twice Solange Alexandre turned down the Légion d'Honneur , saying that she had only done her duty and that others were more worthy.
On receiving the award she said: "It is a great pleasure and a great honour. I am very proud – even if it is only a few weeks, or a few months, before I die."
body_zh: 第二次世界大战期间法国最后一位抵抗运动英雄去世，享年 104 岁。索兰热·亚历山大也是一位罕见的女性，她与未来的丈夫创建并指挥了自己的反德战士部队。
自 1941 年起担任抵抗运动信使后，三年后，她在卢瓦尔河畔吕耶镇附近创立了 Pas-de-Boeuf 网络。
她率领约 30 名士兵组织破坏行动，为盟军飞行员提供庇护，并在 1944 年诺曼底登陆后，加入了对抗德国占领军的战斗。
亚历山大在勒芒一家疗养院去世的消息传出后，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙等人向她表示哀悼。
“她说她只履行了自己的职责。但她的职责是我们的自由。法国永远不会忘记。谢谢你们，”马克龙在社交媒体上发帖称。
索兰热·亚历山大 (Solange Alexandre)，原姓杜布伊松 (Dubuisson)，1922 年出生于法国西部萨尔特省，成长于一个曾在第一次世界大战中受苦受难的爱国家庭。
“我的母亲在战争中失去了第一任丈夫，我的父亲在 1917 年受伤。祖国和荣誉这两个词对我们来说非常重要。它们融入了我的血液中，”她在回忆录中回忆道。
1940年6月，她在广播中听到戴高乐将军在伦敦发出的呼吁，呼吁法国不要放弃对德国的斗争。她从未听说过他，但这并不重要。
“从那一刻起，我就知道我必须加入，”她写道。
几个月后，她父亲的一位朋友——一位出生于突尼斯的法国退伍军人赛义德·贝尔哈法夫（Saïd Belhaffaf）——加入了抵抗运动，招募了她。
她使用代号科莱，骑着自行车穿梭于勒芒周边地区，收集信息并传递信息。
“那时候没有手机，也没有私家车，因为没有汽油。自行车才是王道。”两年前，她在接受采访时说道。
1943 年，她遇到了第一任丈夫盖伊·德里奥 (Guy Déliot)，后者因拒绝逮捕一些犹太人而从法国宪兵部队开小差。
第二年四月，随着盟军入侵的临近，他们决定前往马基，换句话说，秘密生活在森林覆盖的山上，由当地农民提供食物。
他们的成员包括德国强迫劳动计划的逃兵，以及被敌人摧毁的另一支抵抗组织的幸存者。还有两名飞行员，一名美国人和一名加拿大人。
“盖世太保两次来抓我，我两次都从他们手中溜走了，”她后来回忆道。
1944 年 9 月参加解放图尔的行动后，她以法国内政军 (FFI) 中尉军衔结束了战争。
后来，她担任了一名教师，并跟随她的丈夫在法国海外领土担任宪兵军官。 1960 年，他在马提尼克岛被杀，1981 年她再婚。
索兰热·亚历山大两次拒绝了荣誉军团勋章，称她只是尽了自己的职责，其他人更值得。
在获得该奖项时，她说：“这是一种巨大的快乐和巨大的荣誉。我非常自豪——即使这只是我去世前几周或几个月的时间。”

French far-right Eric Zemmour, known for his anti-Islam and anti-immigrant stance, says he’ll be standing in next year’s presidential election.
“I can confirm to you that I will indeed be ⁠a candidate in the presidential election”, Zemmour told TF1 TV, adding that he was running to “keep a France that is French”.

Zemmour, a 68-year-old Jewish author and veteran television commentator, finished fourth in the 2022 presidential election.
This time, he says he wants to expel foreign offenders who are in prison, as well as “foreign unemployed people who have been out of work for more than six months”, even if they are legal residents.
He says he wants “two million fewer immigrants” in France, who are seen by many among the far right as key instigators of violence during last month’s student-led cost of living protests.
Last month’s violence has led to the soaring popularity of frontrunner Marine Le Pen, with whom Zemmour will be competing against in April 2027.
Le Pen, who is the leader of the far-right National Rally party, is widely projected to win the election to replace Emmanuel Macron, who will end his term as president of France.
Meanwhile, far-left candidate Jean-Luc Melenchon of the France Unbowed party, who has been accused of encouraging the unrest, unveiled his programme on Saturday to some 17,000 supporters.

body_en: U.S. mediates Russia-Ukraine talks for 4 hours in Abu Dhabi : NPR

U.S. mediates Russia-Ukraine talks for 4 hours in Abu Dhabi Hopes of progress in ending Europe's biggest conflict since World War II are tempered by the absence of any significant breakthroughs in three previous rounds of talks early this year.

Rustem Umerov, head of Ukraine's foreign intelligence service (third from the right), speaks during the coordination meeting before the trilateral talks between Russia and Ukraine mediated by the U.S. in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, Tuesday. Altaf Qadri/Pool AP hide caption

ABU DHABI, United Arab Emirates — Russia and Ukraine on Tuesday held their first U.S.-mediated talks in nine months on ending the 4 1/2-year-old war, with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio calling the meeting "very productive" and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy saying the session was "constructive and quite substantive."
Europe to join U.S.-brokered Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, defying Kremlin objections
Hopes of ending Europe's biggest conflict since World War II are tempered, however, by the absence of any significant breakthroughs in three previous rounds of talks earlier this year.

There's nothing to suggest a new posture that would lead to a breakthrough, but circumstances surrounding the talks have been changed by the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections as well as increased pressure on Russia's wartime economy. Moscow also is seeking to break Ukrainians' will as another winter sets in by ramping up its battering of the country's power grid.
Neither Rubio nor Zelenskyy attended the talks in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates. The session lasted four hours and another is scheduled for a second day Wednesday.
Melania Trump touts rare agreement she brokered between Russia and Ukraine
Delegations from Moscow and Kyiv met as Washington, represented by U.S. President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner and envoy Steve Witkoff, renewed its push to stop the fighting.

"It looks like the talks in Abu Dhabi were very productive," Rubio said in Paris at the Group of Seven meeting, although he urged patience. "There's a lot of work to be done in that regard. It's not like something that's on the verge of being solved in the next 24 hours or anything like that."

United Arab Emirates Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan sits flanked by Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law (left), and U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff during talks between Russia and Ukraine mediated by the U.S. in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, Tuesday. Altaf Qadri/Pool AP hide caption

Zelenskyy said the talks were largely about humanitarian issues, including prisoner exchanges and returning Ukrainian civilians in captivity, as well as children taken from the country. Security guarantees also were discussed, he added during an appearance at the University of Copenhagen in Denmark.

A senior Ukrainian official who spoke on condition of anonymity because he was not authorized to comment publicly said Ukraine and Russia talked about a large scale prisoner swap, although the details will be discussed in the coming days.
The three-way meeting was the first since February

The two-day session is the first such meeting since February on Russia's full-scale invasion, which analysts and humanitarian organizations say has killed hundreds of thousands of soldiers and thousands of civilians.
Kushner said he believed there were "some good ideas how to bridge" the differences between the two sides.
Trump, whose stance on the war has varied, must reckon with Democrats taking over the U.S. Congress in January following the U.S. elections. Democrats could demand more support for Ukraine.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz told ZDF television Monday night that "I don't have overly high expectations" for the talks.
body_zh: 美国在阿布扎比调解俄罗斯和乌克兰会谈 4 小时：NPR
美国在阿布扎比斡旋俄罗斯与乌克兰谈判长达四个小时 由于今年早些时候的前三轮谈判没有取得任何重大突破，结束欧洲自二战以来最大冲突方面取得进展的希望受到了影响。
周二，乌克兰对外情报部门负责人鲁斯泰姆·乌梅罗夫（右三）在美国斡旋的俄罗斯和乌克兰三方会谈之前的协调会议上发表讲话。 Altaf Qadri/Pool AP 隐藏标题栏
阿拉伯联合酋长国阿布扎比——周二，俄罗斯和乌克兰就结束长达 4.5 年的战争举行了九个月来首次由美国斡旋的会谈，美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥称这次会议“非常富有成效”，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基则表示这次会议“具有建设性且相当实质性”。
欧洲不顾克里姆林宫的反对，参加美国斡旋的阿布扎比​​乌克兰谈判
然而，由于今年早些时候的前三轮谈判没有取得任何重大突破，结束欧洲自二战以来最严重冲突的希望受到了影响。
没有任何迹象表明会采取新的姿态来取得突破，但美国中期选举的结果以及俄罗斯战时经济压力的增加已经改变了谈判的环境。随着另一个冬天的到来，莫斯科还试图通过加大对乌克兰电网的打击力度来打破乌克兰人的意愿。
卢比奥和泽连斯基均未出席在阿联酋首都阿布扎比举行的会谈。会议持续了四个小时，另一场会议定于第二天周三举行。
梅拉尼娅·特朗普吹捧她在俄罗斯和乌克兰之间促成的罕见协议
来自莫斯科和基辅的代表团会面，华盛顿以美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳和特使史蒂夫·威特科夫为代表，再次推动停止战斗。
卢比奥在巴黎七国集团会议上表示，“看来阿布扎比的谈判非常富有成效”，不过他敦促大家保持耐心。 “在这方面还有很多工作要做。这不像是在未来 24 小时内就能解决的问题或类似的事情。”
周二，在美国斡旋下，俄罗斯和乌克兰在阿拉伯联合酋长国阿布扎比举行会谈，阿拉伯联合酋长国外交部长谢赫·阿卜杜拉·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬坐在特朗普总统女婿贾里德·库什纳（左）和美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫的两侧。 Altaf Qadri/Pool AP 隐藏标题栏
泽伦斯基表示，会谈主要讨论人道主义问题，包括交换囚犯、遣返被囚禁的乌克兰平民以及从该国被带走的儿童。他在丹麦哥本哈根大学露面时补充道，安全保障也得到了讨论。
一位因无权公开发表评论而要求匿名的乌克兰高级官员表示，乌克兰和俄罗斯讨论了大规模囚犯交换，不过细节将在未来几天讨论。
这是三方会议自二月份以来的首次会议
这次为期两天的会议是自二月份以来首次就俄罗斯的全面入侵举行此类会议。分析人士和人道主义组织称，俄罗斯的全面入侵已造成数十万士兵和数千平民死亡。
库什纳表示，他相信“有一些好主意可以弥合”双方之间的分歧。
特朗普对战争的立场各不相同，他必须考虑到民主党在美国大选后一月份接管美国国会的情况。民主党可能要求对乌克兰提供更多支持。
德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨周一晚间对德国电视二台表示，“我对此次会谈并没有过高的期望”。

title_en: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
title_zh: 英伟达聘请美国大型律师事务所调查涉嫌中国间谍事件
summary: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.
summary_zh: 这项任命是在黄仁勋与一名据信是中国间谍的女子有染后做出的。
body_en: By Kali Hays , Technology reporter and Lily Jamali , North America Technology correspondent
Nvidia has hired one of the largest law firms in the US to investigate the affair between its own chief executive and an alleged Chinese spy.
Jensen Huang, who co-founded the tech company, has admitted to having a romantic relationship outside of his marriage. The woman, Alice Huang, is alleged to be a spy for Beijing.

Nvidia said on Tuesday that it had hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, and that its attorney Joon Kim would lead "a thorough and independent investigation". The FBI is also conducting its own probe .
The company's share price has fallen almost to a yearly low, with $500bn (£375bn) wiped of its stock market value since Friday.
Nvidia is widely considered one of the most important companies behind the artificial intelligence (AI) boom, given it is the sole manufacturer of a computer chip used in AI tools.
It is the world's second most valuable company after Apple and its chips have become a matter of national security for US officials who are keen to win the AI race.
Alice Huang, who is also known as Huang Le, and is not related to Jensen Huang, was an executive at Singaporean company Megaspeed, which has been a customer of Nvidia.
Megaspeed had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia has said was investigated and debunked.
Nvidia has also maintained that the US government did not inform it that Megaspeed posed an intelligence concern.
What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond
According to the New York Times, Secretary of State Marco Rubio sent a memo to top officials in Washington earlier this year warning that Jensen Huang was in a close relationship with a Chinese spy.
Beijing has rejected claims that the Nvidia chief has been targeted, with its foreign ministry saying the allegations were "intended to smear and malign China".
US President Donald Trump said on Monday that he had spoken to Jensen Huang, who had said he had "no idea she was a spy." Trump said he believed him.
However, the relationship has drawn more political attention. Congressional leaders of the House Committee on Foreign Affairs have asked Huang to appear next week for a closed door briefing.

The Nvidia boss has yet to say whether he will attend, a person familiar with the committee's demand told the BBC. The committee has the authority to subpoena Huang, effectively forcing him to appear before it, if deemed necessary.
When announcing on Sunday that it would investigate the affair, Nvidia's board said it had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised.
It added that a committee of independent directors would oversee the probe.
Wachtell is one of the largest law firms in the US and has several notable clients in the tech industry. Among them are OpenAI and Salesforce.
body_zh: 作者：Kali Hays，科技记者和 Lily Jamali，北美科技记者
英伟达已聘请美国最大的律师事务所之一来调查其首席执行官与一名涉嫌中国间谍之间的事件。
这家科技公司的联合创始人黄仁勋承认，他在婚姻之外有过一段恋爱关系。这名女子名叫爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang)，据称是北京的间谍。
英伟达周二表示，已聘请纽约律师事务所 Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz，其律师 Joon Kim 将领导“彻底、独立的调查”。联邦调查局也在进行自己的调查。
该公司的股价几乎跌至年度低点，自周五以来其股价蒸发了 5000 亿美元（3750 亿英镑）。
英伟达被广泛认为是人工智能（AI）热潮背后最重要的公司之一，因为它是人工智能工具中使用的计算机芯片的唯一制造商。
它是继苹果之后的全球第二大市值公司，其芯片已成为渴望赢得人工智能竞赛的美国官员的国家安全问题。
Alice Huang，又名黄乐，与 Jensen Huang 没有亲属关系，她是新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的高管，该公司一直是 Nvidia 的客户。
Megaspeed 被怀疑帮助将 Nvidia 芯片转移到中国，Nvidia 表示这一担忧已被调查并揭穿。
英伟达还坚称，美国政府没有告知其 Megaspeed 造成了情报问题。
到目前为止，我们对黄仁勋与中国间谍嫌疑人的恋情了解多少
佐伊·克莱曼：英伟达首席执行官的事件将在美国及其他地区引起涟漪
据《纽约时报》报道，国务卿马可·卢比奥今年早些时候向华盛顿高级官员发送了一份备忘录，警告黄仁勋与一名中国间谍关系密切。
北京方面否认了英伟达首席执行官成为攻击目标的说法，中国外交部表示这些指控“旨在抹黑和诽谤中国”。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一表示，他已与黄仁勋通话，黄仁勋表示他“不知道她是间谍”。特朗普说他相信他。
然而，这种关系引起了更多的政治关注。众议院外交事务委员会的国会领导人已要求黄先生下周出席闭门简报会。
一位熟悉委员会要求的人士告诉 BBC，英伟达老板尚未透露是否会参加。如果认为有必要，该委员会有权传唤黄，实际上迫使他出庭。
英伟达董事会周日宣布将调查此事时表示，没有理由相信公司的机密或国家安全受到损害。
它补充说，一个独立董事委员会将监督这项调查。
Wachtell 是美国最大的律师事务所之一，在科技行业拥有数家知名客户。其中包括 OpenAI 和 Salesforce。

title_en: Russia expels Moldovan diplomat in tit-for-tat move
title_zh: 俄罗斯针锋相对驱逐摩尔多瓦外交官
summary: Relations between Moscow and Chisinau have worsened since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
summary_zh: 自2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来，莫斯科和基希讷乌之间的关系恶化。
body_en: Russia expels Moldovan diplomat in tit-for-tat move | Vladimir Putin News | Al Jazeera
Share Russia expels Moldovan diplomat in tit-for-tat move on social media
Russia has expelled a Moldovan diplomat in retaliation for Chisinau’s expulsion of a Russian embassy employee over the crash of a drone in Moldova.

Russia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on Tuesday that it had summoned Moldova’s ambassador, Lilian Darii, and informed him that a member of the Moldovan embassy’s staff had been declared unacceptable “on the basis of the principle of reciprocity”.

“A strong protest was lodged with the ambassador after the Moldovan authorities on October 23 declared an employee of the Russian embassy in Chisinau persona non grata,” the ministry said in a statement.

It said Moldova’s decision was made “under the formal pretext of the alleged discovery on the territory of the republic of debris of an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying explosives”, calling it “another unfriendly step”.
The ministry said the “true goal” of the move was “to further undermine the centuries-long history of Russian-Moldovan relations”.
Last month, Moldovan President Maia Sandu said a “Russian attack drone” had violated the country’s airspace and “crashed near homes and an energy facility”.
Moldova then declared a staff member of the Russian embassy “persona non grata”.
Drones have penetrated Moldovan territory on multiple occasions since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
Since then, Russia’s relations with former Soviet states, such as Moldova, have hit an all-time low, compounded by the push by some of those states to join the European Union.
On Sunday, Moldova officially launched a new power line connecting the country to neighbouring Romania and the European grid to reduce its dependence on Russian energy.
The 400-kilovolt extra-high-voltage line, which runs from the city of Vulcanesti to Chisinau, allows Moldova to cut reliance on the Cuciurgan thermal power plant in Transnistria.

Other European-aligned states in the Black Sea region say they are experiencing renewed attacks allegedly carried out by Moscow, such as a drone strike that sank a cargo ship off Romania’s Black Sea coast in October.
body_zh: 俄罗斯针锋相对驱逐摩尔多瓦外交官弗拉基米尔·普京新闻|半岛电视台
分享 俄罗斯在社交媒体上针锋相对，驱逐摩尔多瓦外交官
俄罗斯驱逐了一名摩尔多瓦外交官，以报复基希讷乌因一架无人机在摩尔多瓦坠毁而驱逐一名俄罗斯大使馆雇员。
俄罗斯外交部周二表示，已召见摩尔多瓦大使利利安·达里伊(Lilian Darii)，并通知他，“基于互惠原则”，摩尔多瓦大使馆的一名工作人员被宣布为不可接受。

list 2 of 3 摩尔多瓦向罗马尼亚开通新电力线以减少对俄罗斯的依赖
莫斯科峰会三场中的三场考验俄罗斯对前苏联盟友的控制力减弱
外交部在一份声明中表示：“摩尔多瓦当局于 10 月 23 日宣布俄罗斯驻基希讷乌大使馆的一名雇员为不受欢迎的人，随后向大使提出了强烈抗议。”
声明称，摩尔多瓦的决定是“以据称在共和国境内发现一架携带爆炸物的无人机残骸为正式借口”做出的，并称这是“又一个不友好的步骤”。
该部表示，此举的“真正目标”是“进一步破坏俄罗斯与摩尔多瓦长达数百年的关系历史”。
上个月，摩尔多瓦总统马亚·桑杜表示，一架“俄罗斯攻击无人机”侵犯了该国领空，并“在房屋和能源设施附近坠毁”。
摩尔多瓦随后宣布俄罗斯大使馆的一名工作人员为“不受欢迎的人”。
自2022年2月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来，无人机已多次侵入摩尔多瓦领土。
此后，俄罗斯与摩尔多瓦等前苏联国家的关系跌至历史最低点，其中一些国家推动加入欧盟，雪上加霜。
周日，摩尔多瓦正式启动了一条连接该国与邻国罗马尼亚和欧洲电网的新电力线，以减少对俄罗斯能源的依赖。
这条400千瓦特高压线路从Vulcanesti市延伸至基希讷乌，使摩尔多瓦能够减少对德涅斯特河沿岸Cuciurgan火力发电厂的依赖。
黑海地区其他与欧洲结盟的国家表示，他们正在遭受据称由莫斯科发动的新一轮袭击，例如 10 月份在罗马尼亚黑海沿岸的一次无人机袭击中击沉了一艘货船。

title_en: Deadly floods hit Iraq as thunderstorms sweep across region
title_zh: 雷暴席卷伊拉克，造成致命洪水袭击
summary: Violent storms lash northern Iraq and parts of Iran, while Portugal faces strong winds and Japan braces for further snowfall Deadly flash floods hit northern Iraq on Saturday as severe thunderstorms swept across the region, including in neighbouring Iran. The
summary_zh: 猛烈风暴袭击伊拉克北部和伊朗部分地区，葡萄牙面临强风，日本准备迎接进一步降雪
body_en: Deadly floods hit Iraq as thunderstorms sweep across region | Environment
Violent storms lash northern Iraq and parts of Iran, while Portugal faces strong winds and Japan braces for further snowfall

Deadly flash floods hit northern Iraq on Saturday as severe thunderstorms swept across the region, including in neighbouring Iran. The city of Erbil, in Iraq, was particularly badly hit, with extensive damage to homes and businesses. Streets were inundated as torrential rain fell over a short period.
Rainfall exceeded forecasts, with an estimated 80mm falling in the city, compared with expectations of 30mm. Two people were killed in the floods.

In Europe, Storm Bruna is forecast to bring strong winds to Portugal this week, particularly along the west coast. Gusts are expected to reach 50mph (80km/h), with heavy rain and thunderstorms also expected. The total rainfall could reach 200mm by the end of the week. The storm has already affected the Canary Islands, where Tenerife recorded a gust of 80mph on Saturday night.
Japan experienced a cold and snowy end to last week, with further snowfall expected in Hokkaido and parts of the mountains in the main island Honshu.

Temperatures in Japan are forecast to fall below the seasonal average early this week, with Sapporo, the capital of Hokkaido prefecture, expected to plunge to 10C below average. Maximum temperatures in the city are likely to be about 4-6C on Monday and Wednesday, while Tuesday’s high is forecast to be about 0C. Minimum temperatures could fall to -6C by Wednesday, and -8C in other western parts of Hokkaido on Tuesday.
Ski resorts are preparing for visitors after snowfall began on Friday. Total snowfall is expected to reach 30-50cm around Kiroro and Niesko, with about 20-30cm in Furano, Rusutsu and Sapporo.
Other resorts could receive up to 20cm of snow by Wednesday. Strong winds accompanied the snow on Friday and over the weekend, with gusts of about 75mph in Kiroko and Niesko.

During the strong El Niño, sea surface temperatures in the equatorial Pacific were about 3.5C above the climatological average at their peak in late October. As a result, Peru has been experiencing air temperatures 5-10C above the seasonal average. The unusually warm conditions expected to continue into next week.
body_zh: 伊拉克遭遇致命洪水，雷暴席卷整个地区环境
猛烈风暴袭击伊拉克北部和伊朗部分地区，葡萄牙面临强风，日本准备迎接进一步降雪
周六，致命的山洪袭击了伊拉克北部，严重的雷暴席卷了该地区，包括邻国伊朗。伊拉克埃尔比勒市受到的打击尤其严重，房屋和企业遭到严重破坏。短时间的倾盆大雨导致街道被淹没。
降雨量超出预期，预计该市降雨量为 80 毫米，而预期为 30 毫米。两人在洪水中丧生。
在欧洲，预计风暴布鲁纳本周将给葡萄牙带来强风，特别是西海岸。阵风预计将达到 50 英里/小时（80 公里/小时），预计还会有大雨和雷暴。到本周末总降雨量可能达到200毫米。风暴已经影响了加那利群岛，特内里费岛周六晚上录得时速 80 英里的阵风。
日本上周经历了寒冷多雪的天气，北海道和本州岛部分山区预计还会有进一步降雪。
预计本周初日本气温将降至季节性平均水平以下，其中北海道首府札幌的气温预计将降至平均水平以下 10 摄氏度。周一和周三该市最高气温可能约为 4-6 摄氏度，预计周二最高气温约为 0 摄氏度。周三最低气温可能降至-6℃，周二北海道西部其他地区最低气温可能降至-8℃。
周五降雪后，滑雪胜地正在为游客做准备。预计Kiroro和Niesko周围的总降雪量将达到30-50厘米，富良野、留寿都和札幌的降雪量约为20-30厘米。
到周三，其他度假村的降雪量可能会达到 20 厘米。周五和周末，强风伴随着降雪，Kiroko 和 Niesko 的阵风时速约为 75 英里/小时。
强厄尔尼诺现象期间，赤道太平洋海面温度比10月下旬峰值时的气候平均值高出约3.5摄氏度。因此，秘鲁的气温比季节平均水平高出 5 至 10 摄氏度。异常温暖的天气预计将持续到下周。

title_en: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
title_zh: 梅根的父亲托马斯·马克尔因涉嫌拆除脚踝监视器而重新被联邦拘留
summary: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.
summary_zh: 这名 82 岁的老人上周因持有儿童性虐待材料被指控在佛罗里达州被软禁。
body_en: By Nardine Saad and Regan Morris , Los Angeles
Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, is back in federal custody in Florida after allegedly removing his ankle monitor, according to court documents.
Markle appeared before a federal magistrate judge in the Florida city of Tampa on Tuesday and was denied bond. Prosecutors say he removed the monitor early that morning.
US Judge Lindsay S Griffin found on Tuesday that Markle had violated the conditions of his pretrial release, court documents show.
Markle, who has denied possessing images of child sex abuse, was arrested in Florida last week and placed under house detention. He was also ordered to wear a location monitoring device.

Griffin described Markle's housing situation as "untenable", writing in the order revoking his pretrial release that "based on the lack of suitable housing, no condition or combination of conditions would reasonably assure the safety of any other person or the community and the defendant's appearance in court".
He also ordered a medical evaluation for Markle and said he "must receive all necessary and prescribed medication unless discontinued by a physician".
"Release conditions are court orders, not suggestions," Bill Essayli, the US attorney for Central California, wrote on X on Tuesday.
"We will continue to prosecute this case to the fullest extent of the law," he added.

Markle, 82, was first arrested last week after the FBI, acting on warrants, searched storage units in Los Angeles registered to him which he had rented since 2008, with the last payment being made in October this year, the DoJ said.
Inside the units the FBI says agents seized about 78 items, including film negatives, slides and books that they allege contained child sex abuse material.
Witnesses "positively identified" Markle in two of the images believed to contain child sex abuse material.
In those images, the man pictured "appears to be in the age range of 30s to 40s", which suggests the alleged abuse dates back decades as Markle is currently 82 years old.
Markle appeared in court last week following his arrest. No plea was taken during the appearance, which set several conditions for his pretrial release, including that he be kept in home detention.
He is charged with one count of possessing indecent images of children, according to the DoJ.
FBI director Kash Patel said last week that Markle "allegedly targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through his criminal actions".
Markle has called the allegations "sick lies".
He moved to the Philippines last year after he had a series of strokes, and lived in Cebu until May. He was reportedly learning to walk again in Florida after having his leg amputated.
The duchess has been estranged from her father since 2018. The BBC understands she broke contact with him last year, telling him she and the authorities knew he had abused young girls.
In a previously shared statement, Meghan confirmed the existence of the letter and wrote: "I am deeply distressed... my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed."
body_zh: 作者：Nardine Saad 和 Regan Morris，洛杉矶
法庭文件显示，苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根的父亲托马斯·马克尔因涉嫌取下脚踝监视器而重新被佛罗里达州联邦拘留。
周二，马克尔在佛罗里达州坦帕市接受联邦地方法官的审讯，但被拒绝保释。检察官称，他当天一早就把显示器移走了。
法庭文件显示，美国法官林赛·S·格里芬周二裁定，马克尔违反了审前释放的条件。
马克尔否认拥有儿童性虐待的照片，上周在佛罗里达州被捕并被软禁。他还被命令佩戴位置监控装置。
格里芬将马克尔的住房状况描述为“站不住脚”，并在撤销其审前释放的命令中写道，“由于缺乏合适的住房，任何条件或条件组合都无法合理保证任何其他人或社区的安全以及被告出庭的安全”。
他还下令对马克尔进行医疗评估，并表示他“必须接受所有必要的处方药物，除非医生停药”。
“释放条件是法院命令，而不是建议，”加州中部美国检察官比尔·埃萨利 (Bill Essayli) 周二在 X 上写道。
他补充说：“我们将继续在法律允许的最大范围内起诉此案。”
美国司法部表示，82 岁的马克尔于上周首次被捕，此前联邦调查局根据逮捕令搜查了他在洛杉矶注册的储藏室，这些储藏室是他自 2008 年以来租用的，最后一次付款是在今年 10 月。
FBI 表示，探员在这些单位内查获了约 78 件物品，其中包括他们声称含有儿童性虐待材料的电影底片、幻灯片和书籍。
目击者在其中两张据信包含儿童性虐待内容的照片中“肯定地识别出了”马克尔。
在这些照片中，照片中的男子“年龄似乎在 30 岁到 40 岁之间”，这表明涉嫌的虐待行为可以追溯到几十年前，而马克尔目前已经 82 岁了。
马克尔被捕后于上周出庭。出庭期间没有提出任何抗辩，这为他的审前释放设定了一些条件，包括将他软禁在家里。
据司法部称，他被指控一项拥有儿童不雅图像的罪名。
联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔上周表示，马克尔“据称以无辜儿童为目标，并试图通过犯罪行为窃取他们的清白”。
马克尔称这些指控是“病态的谎言”。
去年，他经历了一系列中风后搬到了菲律宾，并在宿雾住到了五月。据报道，他在腿部截肢后正在佛罗里达州重新学习走路。
自 2018 年以来，公爵夫人就与父亲疏远了。BBC 获悉，她去年与父亲断绝了联系，并告诉父亲，她和当局都知道他曾虐待年轻女孩。
在之前分享的一份声明中，梅根证实了这封信的存在，并写道：“我深感悲痛……我的想法与所有可能受到伤害的孩子在一起。”

title_en: UNIFIL patrol comes under fire in southern Lebanon
title_zh: 联黎部队巡逻队在黎巴嫩南部遭到袭击
summary: UNIFIL said on Tuesday that 'about a dozen rounds' were fired at one of its patrols, without identifying the assailants.
summary_zh: 联黎部队周二表示，其一支巡逻队遭到“大约十几发子弹”，但没有透露袭击者的身份。
body_en: UNIFIL patrol comes under fire in southern Lebanon | Hezbollah News | Al Jazeera
Share UNIFIL patrol comes under fire in southern Lebanon on social media
A United Nations peacekeeping force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) patrol has come under fire in southern Lebanon, the force said.
UNIFIL said on Tuesday that “about a dozen rounds” were fired at one of its patrols near Wadi Jilu, in Lebanon’s Tyre district, without specifying the entity behind the shooting.

The patrol returned fire, after which the shooting stopped. UNIFIL reported no casualties and called for an investigation.

“We reiterate the obligation under international law for all actors to ensure the safety and security of UN personnel and property at all times. Deliberate attacks on peacekeepers are violations of Security Council resolution 1701 and international humanitarian law,” UNIFIL said.
UNIFIL is a peacekeeping mission established by the UN Security Council in March 1978, days after Israel invaded Lebanon.
The force has acted as a buffer between Israel and Lebanon ever since, but its presence has been unable to prevent several rounds of conflict, including the latest between Israel and Hezbollah.

Israel continues to occupy swaths of southern Lebanon, despite a so-called ceasefire and a US-brokered framework agreement through which the Israeli military would withdraw from those areas and the Lebanese army would move in to disarm Hezbollah.
French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said on Tuesday that the G7 foreign ministers agreed on “the need to avoid a security void” in Lebanon after the UNIFIL mandate expires at the end of 2026.
The foreign ministers backed “the need to move quickly toward a new security architecture”, Barrot said after the group met in Paris.
However, the French foreign minister acknowledged that there had been no breakthrough regarding replacing UNIFIL, which comprises some 7,500 personnel from nearly 50 countries.
The UN Security Council last year voted, under US pressure, to end UNIFIL’s mandate on December 31, 2026. Lebanese officials have called for the mandate to be extended.

联合国驻黎巴嫩维和部队（联黎部队）表示，一支巡逻队在黎巴嫩南部遭到袭击。
联黎部队周二表示，黎巴嫩提尔区 Wadi Jilu 附近的一支巡逻队遭到“大约十几发子弹”，但没有具体说明枪击事件背后的实体。

巡逻队还击，枪击事件随后停止。联黎部队报告没有人员伤亡，并呼吁进行调查。
联黎部队表示：“我们重申，根据国际法，所有行为体都有义务确保联合国人员和财产的安全。蓄意袭击维和人员违反了安理会第 1701 号决议和国际人道主义法。”
联黎部队是联合国安理会于 1978 年 3 月以色列入侵黎巴嫩几天后成立的维和部队。
从那时起，这支部队一直充当以色列和黎巴嫩之间的缓冲力量，但它的存在无法阻止几轮冲突，包括以色列和真主党之间的最新冲突。
以色列继续占领黎巴嫩南部的大片地区，尽管存在所谓的停火和美国斡旋的框架协议，根据该协议，以色列军队将从这些地区撤军，黎巴嫩军队将进驻以解除真主党的武装。
法国外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗周二表示，联黎部队授权将于 2026 年底到期后，七国集团外长一致认为黎巴嫩“需要避免安全真空”。
巴罗特在巴黎会议后表示，各国外交部长支持“迅速建立新安全架构的必要性”。
不过，法国外长承认，在更换联黎部队方面没有取得突破，该部队由来自近50个国家的约7500名人员组成。
去年，在美国的压力下，联合国安理会投票决定于 2026 年 12 月 31 日结束联黎部队的任期。黎巴嫩官员呼吁延长联黎部队的任期。

body_en: Erin Ogunkeye is pleased to welcome Rafe Pilling, Director of Threat Intelligence in the Sophos Counter Threat Unit (CTU). How can a minor cyber intrusion disrupt food supplies, expose the weaknesses of industrial infrastructure and become an instrument of geopolitical confrontation? The cyberattacks targeting supermarket refrigeration systems in France offer a revealing illustration of how digital vulnerabilities can translate into tangible economic disruption and potentially broader threats to society. As Pilling explains, “With a small amount of effort from the adversary side, they can create a large impact, in this case destroying food and producing empty shelves or empty refrigeration units in stores.” This asymmetry lies at the heart of contemporary cyber conflict, in which modest technical interventions can produce disproportionate economic and operational consequences

body_en: White House announces funds for law enforcement programme in several cities | Donald Trump News | Al Jazeera
Share White House announces funds for law enforcement programme in several cities on social media

The administration of United States President Donald Trump has said that it will award the cities of St Louis, Missouri, and Jackson, Mississippi, more than $60m each to expand law enforcement resources as part of a bid to combat violent crime.
The White House stated in a social media post on Tuesday that the so-called “Model Cities Initiative” would help the municipalities increase their capacity for prosecutions and policing activities.

“The Model Cities Initiative reflects the Trump Administration’s commitment to reducing crime across the country and ensuring the safety of every American,” Attorney General Todd Blanche said in a press release describing the programme last month.
The initiative has said that it will distribute nearly $300m for such efforts among the cities of St Louis and Jackson, along with Jacksonville, Florida, and Baton Rouge, Louisiana.

The Trump administration has promoted a largely punitive approach to combatting crime in cities across the country, including controversial steps such as the deployment of the National Guard to large, Democrat-led cities that have drawn accusations of executive overreach, civil liberties violations and political intimidation.

While Trump and his supporters have credited their policies with a drop in violent crime, that trend predates his return to office and has taken place in cities with a wide variety of approaches towards criminal justice across the country.

Homicides in St Louis, for example, have been falling for several years after a brief surge during the COVID-19 pandemic, and hit their lowest levels in more than a decade during the first half of 2026.
While Democratic officials have denounced Trump’s crackdowns, some Republican-led states have embraced them.
The government deployed members of several federal agencies to the city of Memphis , Tennessee, governed by Democrats at the local level but located in a Republican-led state.
The Trump administration has touted that effort as an inspiration for the Model Cities Initiative along with other cases, such as Washington, DC.
The government has hailed the Memphis deployment as a success, but some residents and civil liberties groups have accused the task force of widespread civil rights violations and excessive force.

A video released earlier this month as part of an investigation into a shooting by a member of the Tennessee National Guard, deployed in Memphis as part of Trump’s task force, showed the soldiers aiming their guns at a man as he lay dying on the street after being shot in the back.

司法部长托德·布兰奇上个月在描述该计划的新闻稿中表示：“模范城市计划反映了特朗普政府对减少全国犯罪并确保每个美国人安全的承诺。”
该倡议表示，将向圣路易斯市、杰克逊市、佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔市和路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日市分配近 3 亿美元，用于此类工作。
特朗普政府在全国各地的城市推行了一种基本上是惩罚性的打击犯罪的措施，包括向民主党领导的大城市部署国民警卫队等有争议的措施，这些措施招致了行政越权、侵犯公民自由和政治恐吓的指控。
尽管特朗普和他的支持者将暴力犯罪的下降归功于他们的政策，但这种趋势早在他重返办公室之前就已经出现，并且已经发生在全国各地刑事司法方法多种多样的城市。
例如，圣路易斯的凶杀案在 COVID-19 大流行期间短暂激增后，多年来一直在下降，并在 2026 年上半年达到十多年来的最低水平。
尽管民主党官员谴责特朗普的镇压行动，但一些共和党领导的州却对此表示欢迎。
政府将多个联邦机构的成员部署到田纳西州孟菲斯市，该市在地方一级由民主党人管辖，但位于共和党领导的州。
特朗普政府将这一努力与华盛顿特区等其他案例一起吹捧为“模范城市倡议”的灵感来源。
政府称赞孟菲斯的部署是成功的，但一些居民和公民自由团体指责特别工作组广泛侵犯公民权利和过度使用武力。
本月早些时候发布的一段视频是对田纳西州国民警卫队一名成员枪击事件的调查的一部分，该国民警卫队是特朗普特遣部队的一部分，部署在孟菲斯。视频显示，一名男子背部中弹，倒在街上，生命垂危，士兵们用枪瞄准了他。

title_en: Spain's king and queen attend memorial service for rail crash victims
title_zh: 西班牙国王和王后出席铁路事故遇难者追悼会
summary: Sixty-nine people died in the collision near Toledo two weeks ago and 28 are still in hospital.
summary_zh: 两周前托莱多附近发生的车祸造成 69 人死亡，28 人仍在医院接受治疗。
body_en: Spain's King Felipe and Queen Letizia were among those who have attended a memorial service in tribute to the 69 victims of last month's deadly train crash.

The accident occurred when one train, travelling at high speed, ploughed into the back of another that was stationary on the Madrid-Seville line, near the small town of Urda, about 40 miles from Toledo.
It was the worst rail tragedy in Spain since 2013. Twenty-eight people remain in hospital.
"The tragic accident in Urda has left our families, our towns and our society with a pain that is difficult to accept," Archbishop Cerro Chaves told those present.

Representatives of those killed carried lit candles to the front of the cathedral and placed them next to the main altar. The first reading of the service was by Ana Benítez, sister of David Benítez, a 38-year-old father-of-two who died.
The king and queen were met with applause by bystanders as they entered the cathedral and at the end of the service, after Catholic Mass, they spoke to relatives of the victims.

Senior politicians also attended the service, including the leader of the opposition People's Party, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, the president of the Castilla-La Mancha region, Emiliano García-Page, and Transport and Economy Minister Carlos Cuerpo.
Cuerpo took on the transport portfolio following the resignation last week of Óscar Puente from the post.
Puente had come under mounting pressure following the crash, Spain's second major rail tragedy this year after 46 people died in a collision on the same high-speed line in January.
Some local people from the town of Adamuz in Andalusia, where that accident happened, as well as residents of Urda, were present for the memorial service.
The investigation into the recent accident is still in progress. Puente suggested that human error combined with a glitch in the safety system may have been the cause.
The tragedy happened a month before the 29 November general election and is seen as likely to hurt Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's attempts to secure re-election.
The ceremony took place on the same day as a nationwide strike by train drivers, who are demanding greater safety on the rail network.
Rail services were also expected to be affected across the country on Wednesday due to a general strike, led by housing activists calling for urgent measures to control rental costs.

body_zh: 西班牙国王费利佩和王后莱蒂齐亚出席了悼念活动，悼念上个月致命火车事故中的 69 名遇难者。
事故发生时，一列高速行驶的火车撞上了马德里-塞维利亚线上静止的另一列火车的车尾，该火车位于乌尔达小镇附近，距托莱多约 40 英里。
这是自 2013 年以来西班牙最严重的铁路事故。目前有 28 人仍在医院接受治疗。
“乌尔达的悲惨事故给我们的家庭、我们的城镇和我们的社会带来了难以接受的痛苦，”大主教塞罗·查韦斯告诉在场的人。
遇难者代表将点燃的蜡烛带到大教堂前面，并将它们放在主祭坛旁边。首先宣读仪式的是安娜·贝尼特斯，她是已故的 38 岁两个孩子的父亲大卫·贝尼特斯的妹妹。
国王和王后进入大教堂时受到了旁观者的掌声，仪式结束后，天主教弥撒结束后，他们向遇难者亲属发表了讲话。
高级政界人士也出席了仪式，包括反对党人民党领袖阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费霍、卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰地区主席埃米利亚诺·加西亚-佩奇以及交通和经济部长卡洛斯·库尔波。
上周奥斯卡·普恩特 (Óscar Puente) 辞职后，库尔波 (Cuerpo) 接手了交通运输业务。
事故发生后，普恩特承受着越来越大的压力，这是西班牙今年第二起重大铁路事故，此前一月份，同一条高速线路发生了一起事故，造成 46 人死亡。
事故发生地安达卢西亚阿达穆兹镇的一些当地人以及乌尔达的居民出席了追悼会。
对近期发生的事故的调查仍在进行中。普恩特认为，人为错误和安全系统故障可能是原因。
这场悲剧发生在 11 月 29 日大选前一个月，被认为可能会损害社会党总理佩德罗·桑切斯争取连任的努力。
仪式在全国范围内火车司机罢工的同一天举行，他们要求提高铁路网络的安全性。
由于住房活动人士呼吁采取紧急措施控制租金成本，预计周三全国范围内的铁路服务也会受到总罢工的影响。
